app.title: Pele – Mermaid diagrams as themeable SVG
app.author: dchest
app.description: A lightweight library that renders Mermaid diagrams into themeable SVG using React.
proposed_tests: Render a simple Mermaid graph in a test React app
Verify that the output SVG contains expected class names
Measure render time for a graph with 50 nodes
Test theme customization via CSS variables
